title: Macedonian celebrant-book research: new public API bounds, contrary controls and unresolved exact-book evidence
semantics: Zero source-candidate, stage, transition, ancestry, operative-use or completeness promotions. Existing approval-only coverage, memberships, rights and unauthenticated mixed-rite title leads remain unchanged. Search result rows are neither books nor recensions.

expected_list.required_input: Authenticated original title and imprint leaves, publisher/place/pagination and holding-copy identity.

expected_list.target: Approval leaf tied to that printed book
expected_list.required_input: Original book approbation/decree leaf or equivalent exact-book authority record; 9 December2009 notice alone is insufficient.
Translator/publisher/authority statement identifying exact source edition, with original pages or equivalent primary documentation.
Public holding record or identifiable Catholic celebrant copy linked to exact title/imprint; local event reports do not identify the book.

expected_list.target: Dated operative use of the approved wording
expected_list.required_input: Dated implementation or celebration evidence identifying the exact book/wording; the2022 event report names neither language nor book.
Complete source or authenticated contents/page census covering named liturgies, preparation, rubrics, thanksgiving, propers and complementary books as applicable.

expected_list.target: Independent substantive state or transmission edge
expected_list.required_input: Concrete component-level checked before/after or reception evidence; no parent or stage follows from permission, dates, titles or photographs.

fresh_findings.finding: Both delivered exact-title search hits were read completely and concern Roman/historical missal contexts. The local word Литургикон alone is not a Byzantine-book identity.
The donated liturgical set is explicitly a Roman Missal and evangeliary. It is not evidence of receipt of the Macedonian Byzantine2009 book.

fresh_findings.locus: extracted lines concerning the scheduled papal liturgy on Skopje square; article published22March2019
fresh_findings.finding: The bishop describes the planned papal Mass in Latin and Macedonian and participant booklets. This is neither a complete celebrant book nor actual Byzantine implementation evidence.

A parish report describes an actual Catholic celebration and clergy from both jurisdictions. It names no celebrant edition, language, source exemplar or approved wording. Rite cannot be inferred solely from the term Liturgy or mixed clergy. The unrelated footer includes obvious theme placeholders and is not evidence of parish location or service languages.

fresh_findings.locus: media39930; complete parent article line9; complete1000×563 photograph
fresh_findings.finding: The single media hit is captioned as the Pope with a new Liturgikon in August2020. The photograph shows open pages, not an authenticated target title or approval leaf. No exact edition is assigned from the image.

The inspected historical/language passages, publication paragraph and15-title recommendation list do not supply the requested2009 title/imprint/approval or exact exemplar. General historical language testimony and devotional publishing are not service-book authentication.

fresh_findings.locus: Anubis challenge body/version1.25.0-izum; DLIB anchor on all three National Library service pages
fresh_findings.finding: The direct title-field COBISS request delivered an HTTP200 proof-of-work challenge, not catalogue results. National Library pages are publisher/user/librarian services, not annual bibliography volumes; DLIB is literally href=#. No annual volume was searched. No challenge was bypassed.
https://biskupija.mk/ failed DNS resolution; https://www.dlib.mk/ timed out. No source bytes or holding results were obtained from either route.

searches.method: Public web discovery followed by complete direct HTTP response acquisition. Search-rendered snippets were leads only, never source wording.
searches.limit: Queries were sent in batches. No per-query zero-hit claims; no exhaustive web, library, national bibliography or Church archive census. Non-primary summaries and the current project-derived Domus Dei page were not used as independent evidence.

searches.method: Whole direct public WordPress search/media responses; delivered rows reconciled individually.
